about.title: About me
about.text: I'm Berk, a Fullstack Developer with a background in Mechanical Engineering. Before moving into software, I worked in quality and project engineering — roles that trained me to look closely at details, follow processes rigorously, and never ship something I haven't fully understood. That mindset carried directly into coding: I care about why something works, not just that it works.

points.location: Based in Arnsberg, Germany — open to remote work and relocation for the right opportunity.
points.learning: Coming from engineering, I'm used to learning new tools and standards quickly, and I stay curious about new technologies in web development.
points.problemSolving: My real passion has always been problem solving — breaking a complex issue into smaller pieces and working through it methodically until it's resolved.

skills.title: Skill Set
skills.text: I focus on building clean, accessible interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and I'm growing my skills across the full stack with Angular, TypeScript and backend fundamentals. I make a point of staying current with new tools and best practices, because web development moves fast and I don't want to fall behind.

cta.text: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.description: Take a look at a few of my projects below — click on one to see it in more detail.

join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.

elPolloLoco.description: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.

pokedex.description: Responsive Pokédex that fetches live data from the PokéAPI. Browse Pokémon cards, search by name, and explore detailed stats, types and evolution chains in an interactive dialog.

contact.title: Let's work together
contact.aboutText: Have an idea or a role in mind? I'd love to hear about it and see how I can help bring it to life.
